en: A sepia-toned historical postcard image showing a quiet street scene in a small town. The street, lined with residential and possibly some commercial buildings, leads the viewer's eye toward a prominent church with Gothic-style architecture. There are a few telephone poles and overhead wires visible, and trees partially frame the right side of the image. The photo has an old-fashioned feel, likely early to mid-20th century. The bottom of the card has German text labeling the location.
